verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents automated recurring payments, custom pricing plans, and trial and renewal handling. Subscriptions can be created, updated, and cancelled via the API, with a customer portal for self-service management and subscription checkout. A community user also reports getting recurring payments running in under an hour. missing for 10: no evidence of proration behavior on plan changes, no dedicated documentation of upgrade/downgrade flows beyond generic subscription update, and only thin independent corroboration.
